artifact.name: S1-base ModernBERT seeds1002/1003 confirmatory matrix specification

purpose: Measure whether the positive seed1001 ModernBERT standalone and P5 sequence-replacement results are stable to initialization and deterministic minibatch order.

training.shuffle: stable SHA256 package order per epoch
training.checkpoint_selection: validation raw average precision; ties by AUROC, lower validation loss, then earlier epoch
training.resume: model, optimizer, epoch, history, and all RNG states

post_matrix_confirmation_protocol.standalone_report: mean and sample standard deviation of raw AP and component-isolated OOF F1
post_matrix_confirmation_protocol.fusion_report: replace only P5 sequence margin separately for each seed under the frozen S1-FUS five-fold protocol
post_matrix_confirmation_protocol.strong_statistical_support_additional_co: hierarchical seed-component bootstrap 95% CI lower bound is nonnegative
post_matrix_confirmation_protocol.interpretation: The stability decision and the stronger CI condition are reported separately; the latter is not retroactively required to call a direction stable.

decision.if_stability_confirmed: retain S1-FUS as the leading complete development candidate, while sequence-side architectural novelty remains a separate question
decision.if_not_confirmed: retain frozen P5 as the stable complete development reference
decision.test_policy: test remains locked until architecture and final freeze are complete
